plan.title: GH_REPO in parent shell breaks pr-wait-mergeable tests during task check / release

narratives.Description: GH_REPO in parent shell breaks pr-wait-mergeable tests during task check / release
narratives.Overview:
## Summary

First v0.78.0 production `task release` Step 5 failed `task check` in part because `packages/core/src/pr-wait-mergeable/main.test.ts` failed when the parent shell had `GH_REPO` set. Clearing `GH_REPO` made the targeted re-run pass.

## Fix

Clear `GH_REPO` in `beforeEach` of `main.test.ts` (or pin fixtures via args that win). Exclusive file: `main.test.ts` — do not edit `main.ts` (owned by #2581).

## Acceptance

- Tests pass with `GH_REPO` set in parent shell
- Sibling audit documented
- CHANGELOG entry
